# ![](https://app.gusto.com/companies/adca0b57-efa1-4f15-bbb4-2c02200cafbf/logo?v=1785255130)    The Anything Group LLCHead of Marketing  Remote  ·   Contractor  [Company website](https://theanythinggroup.com/careers/)    [Apply for Head of Marketing](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/the-anything-group-llc-head-of-marketing-57669335-4ed4-4edf-b565-6ff4232e9ba4/applicants/new)

This role is responsible for leading the day-to-day execution of the marketing function across all TAG brands, ensuring strategic initiatives are translated into high-quality campaigns, content, and brand experiences. This role bridges strategy and operations, driving team performance, cross-functional collaboration, and scalable execution systems that support business growth.

### About The Anything Group LLC

The Anything Group (TAG) was built by industry leaders to form a growth-focused organization rooted in emotive engagement, strategic creative and unparalleled management agency.

All our group of businesses are built together to ensure we deliver forward thinking expertise, client service, data analysis, and tailored strategies for our clients' revenue growth. We are proud to be among North America's highest revenuing digital marketing agencies, supporting large and small clients worldwide.

Our mission

TAG is on a mission to generate positive business with a positive impact. We partner with companies to meet their goals by providing exceptional customer service and innovative solutions to boost their return on marketing spend (ROAS) through emotive marketing, impactful engaging content and management solutions. This allows us to be the all-in-one agency that every client desires while empowering a culture to harness the talent, uniqueness and passion of our team to be a group of phenomenal individuals that are committed to making an impact on every part of every community we are a part of. We will achieve our goals of creating impactful engagement and exponential growth, by not just being leading experts, but by being a globally minded, respectful, compassionate, trustworthy and a company that is a joy to work with.

Our vision

Our vision is to be the top engagement agency, bringing our best every day with personalized approaches and outstanding quality for real emotive connections. We're a team of individuals who support and honor each other and our clients to strive for excellence.

Anything but ordinary \| TAG along!

### Description

This role is responsible for leading the day-to-day execution of the marketing function across all TAG brands, ensuring strategic initiatives are translated into high-quality campaigns, content, and brand experiences. This role bridges strategy and operations, driving team performance, cross-functional collaboration, and scalable execution systems that support business growth.

Mission & Responsibilities

- Lead the execution of marketing initiatives across channels, ensuring campaigns, content, events, and partnerships are delivered on time and to a high standard.
- Oversee operational planning and coordination of marketing activities to create structure, accountability, and consistency across the team.
- Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans with clear ownership, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
- Support the implementation of brand strategy across all touchpoints, ensuring consistency in messaging, positioning, and visual identity.
- Manage campaign development and execution to strengthen market presence and drive audience engagement.
- Ensure all external communications align with brand standards and broader business objectives.
- Track, analyze, and optimize marketing performance against defined KPIs to deliver measurable business impact.
- Provide regular reporting and actionable insights on campaign effectiveness, operational efficiency, and growth opportunities.
- Use data-driven decision-making to continuously improve marketing outcomes and team productivity.
- Partner closely with Sales, Product, and Leadership teams to align marketing efforts with pipeline generation, product positioning, and company goals.
- Facilitate clear communication and cross-functional collaboration to maximize efficiency and business results.
- Lead and support the marketing team in daily operations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Build scalable processes, workflows, and systems that support sustainable growth.
- Identify capability gaps and contribute to team development and resource planning.
- Drive operational excellence through disciplined project management, improved workflows, and seamless coordination across functions.

Personal & Professional skills

- Strong proficiency in project management tools for planning and execution.
- Advanced use of CRM and sales enablement tools to align marketing with pipeline generation.
- Experience with email marketing and automation platforms.
- Strong command of analytics and reporting tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Looker Studio).
- Familiarity with content management systems (e.g. WordPress, Webflow).
- Working knowledge of SEO and digital performance tools.
- Competency in social media and scheduling tools.
- Ability to use design and creative collaboration tools.
- Comfort with AI-powered productivity tools.
- Operational mindset with excellent execution skills
- Strategic thinking with attention to detail
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management
- Strong understanding of branding, campaigns, and digital marketing
- Data-driven decision-making and analytical thinking
- Adaptability in fast-paced, evolving environments
- Problem-solving and process improvement orientation
- High level of professionalism and confidentiality

Working conditions & Benefits

- Full-time, working from 9am – 5pm PST Monday to Friday.
- Remote work.
- 25 days of PTO per year.
- Internet, healthcare and gym monthly reimbursements.
- Christmas break (we close from Christmas to New Year’s).
- Birthday off (with gift included).

[Apply for Head of Marketing](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/the-anything-group-llc-head-of-marketing-57669335-4ed4-4edf-b565-6ff4232e9ba4/applicants/new)
